t: Carbon monoxide (CO) detector powered by a long-life sealed battery. Designed to accurately measure low levels of CO. Featuring an advanced electrochemical sensor calibrated and tested in CO gas. Memory function indicates previous alarm activation. Features prominent visual alarm notification and advanced diagnostics support via cable. Ideal in any room that contains a fuel burning burning appliance e.g gas hob, open fire, boiler. Suitable for home and / or travel use.
